description: Architecting Oona Insurance's on-premise AEM platform and its Dispatcher and CloudFront environments. Leading development of the React-based D2C and Kahoona products, reorganizing the AEM codebase, and moving legacy APIs to persisted AEM GraphQL queries.
points: Own technical decisions for AEM Sites and Assets cloud operations, leading a team of 3–5 developers, QA engineers and architects through pre-production and production deployments.
Maintain the Dispatcher and AWS CloudFront configuration, including cache and CSP policies, for 100% regulatory compliance.
Made GraphQL persisted queries the team's data-fetching standard: 70% less over-fetching, 30% faster frontend delivery and 50% faster page loads with caching and preloading.
Defined the SCSS architecture standard, cutting CSS bundle size by 40% and font load time by 50%.
Moved PromoCodes logic into Java servlets to remove credential-leak risk, and reworked dialogs and templates to cut authoring effort by 20%.
Designed the Resource Center for Kahoona agents, which cut support queries by 60% and became the sales team's knowledge base.
